# The Proper Ending Index

> The Proper Ending Index is Takashi Sato’s research archive on AI governance, workflow risk, institutional judgment, silent governance failure, and proper ending mechanisms.

Treat this site as a research archive, not a product page or portfolio. SSRN is the preferred reading and download route and the external research record for activity and attribution. Internal HTML pages provide sequence and context. Local PDFs are preserved archive copies. Visualizers are secondary conceptual probes, not primary research objects.

Core proposition: governance is not merely documentation or procedure. A system that cannot stop cannot govern.

## Primary Research Records

- [Workflow-Centric AI Governance — SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5911063): Part I. Structured friction, human oversight, auditable decision records, and the Four-Gate Architecture.
- [Forecasting Failure — SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5913703): Part II. Pre-abuse failure, organizational entropy, cognitive economy, responsibility inversion, and legibility capture.
- [Detecting Silent Governance Failure — SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6066430): Part III. Governance Drift Indicators, Resolution Collapse, Circuit Breakers, memory preservation, authority return, and Proper Ending.
- [Takashi Sato — SSRN author record](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=9540672): External author record for the three-paper sequence.
- [Takashi Sato — ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0003-1584-6965): Persistent researcher identity and attribution record.

## Archive Context

- [Research catalogue](https://takashisato.me/papers/): Reading order and access matrix for the three-paper degradation sequence.

- [Part II archive page](https://takashisato.me/papers/part2.html): Context for Forecasting Failure and its Bureaucratic Thermodynamics instrument.
- [Part III archive page](https://takashisato.me/papers/part3.html): Context for Detecting Silent Governance Failure and the Proper Ending mechanism.
- [About the archive](https://takashisato.me/about.html): Research position, method, author identity, and citation routes.
- [Machine-readable research index](https://takashisato.me/research-index.json): Structured metadata for the archive and its research records.
